title: Find a door: 0.2 s detector
description: The same door with 0.2 s inference instead of 0.1 s. A detection is used only while under 0.5 s old, and a new one starts at most every 0.4 s at 10 Hz, so the cached detection can expire just before the next result arrives.
knownIssue: Target freshness (0.5 s) is close to detector cadence (~0.4 s) plus inference; with ≥ 0.15 s inference the tap drops out for a tick every cycle.
